matrix.macrotrackr: Weight and habits free, meals on Pro

faqs.question: Why switch from MyFitnessPal to MacroTrackr?
faqs.answer: Barcode scanning, gram-accurate macro targets and weekly averages are on the free plan, with no ads on any plan. The hosted free plan shows your last 7 days; Pro opens your full history. Self-hosting has no plan limits and keeps your data on your own server.

faqs.question: Does MacroTrackr have an open food database?
faqs.answer: Yes. MacroTrackr connects directly to the OpenFoodFacts database with millions of verified global grocery products, along with full support for custom ingredients and saved meals.

faqs.question: Is MacroTrackr free?
faqs.answer: MacroTrackr is open source (AGPLv3) and free to self-host with Docker, with no plan limits. The hosted version has a free plan that shows your last 7 days and keeps 5 saved meals, and Pro at $3.99 a month for full history, unlimited saved meals and 30 and 90 day trends.

faqs.question: How does MacroTrackr differ from MacroFactor?
faqs.answer: MacroFactor is a subscription-only app built around adaptive expenditure coaching, with a manual mode for people who set their own targets. MacroTrackr is open source and free to self-host: you set your own targets from formulas you can read, and weekly averages are on every plan.

faqs.question: Can I track weekly averages in MacroTrackr?
faqs.answer: Yes. MacroTrackr shows weekly averages and a consistency score, so you can judge long-term trends rather than single-day spikes.

faqs.question: When should I choose MacroTrackr over Cronometer?
faqs.answer: If you primarily care about hitting calorie and macronutrient targets (protein, carbs, fats) with high speed and zero ads, MacroTrackr provides a faster and cleaner experience than Cronometer's micronutrient-heavy dashboard.

faqs.question: Can I self-host MacroTrackr at home?
faqs.answer: Yes. MacroTrackr runs as a single Docker container with an embedded SQLite database, which is enough for a Raspberry Pi, Unraid, Synology or any home server.
